title: oci-project.json
description: Per-project values of spec-oci-images, at the root of the repository that holds the image directories.

$conforms_to.description: The spec version the file conforms to.

vendor.description: The organisation, for the vendor label.

authors.description: Contact details of the people or organisation responsible; joined with ', ' into the authors label.

source.description: URL of the repository that holds the image directories.

registry_host.description: The registry host images are published to.

label_ns.description: Prefix of the project's own label keys, in reverse-DNS form.

prefix.description: Prefix of the project's variables in the version file.
